metadata.title: 5-Fluorouracil, Epirubicin 100 and Cyclophosphamide (FEC100)
metadata.indication: Neoadjuvant or adjuvant treatment for breast carcinoma.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled encoding · independent clinical and pharmacy review pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: NCCP source and boundary cases reviewed; not clinical validation or authorisation.

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.
metadata.schedule_summary: Fluorouracil, epirubicin and cyclophosphamide on Day 1 every 21 days for six cycles. Radiotherapy must not overlap FEC.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the current NCCP source. It does not replace the official regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review, or pharmacy verification.

rule_engine.conflict_policy: Return the most restrictive applicable action and display every triggered rule.
rule_engine.missing_data_policy: Evaluate only supplied values. Do not infer missing values and do not block a partial assessment.

action.recommendation: At the beginning of a cycle, ANC<1.5 or platelets<100 requires one-week delay. The after-delay table is a separate decision; confirm context and prior febrile neutropenia.

rules.explanation: At the beginning of a cycle, ANC<1.5 or platelets<100 requires one-week delay. The after-delay table is a separate decision; confirm context and prior febrile neutropenia.

action.recommendation: Nadir counts alone must not cause a FEC dose reduction. Assess infection/bleeding urgently if indicated and obtain the actual Day 1 counts; never use a nadir result to clear the next cycle.

rules.explanation: Nadir counts alone must not cause a FEC dose reduction. Assess infection/bleeding urgently if indicated and obtain the actual Day 1 counts; never use a nadir result to clear the next cycle.

action.recommendation: After a one-week delay, use Table1 only if there was no previous febrile neutropenia. Confirm both counts, occurrence number, previous dose and G-CSF plan; otherwise use Table2. No automatic dose is calculated.

rules.explanation: After a one-week delay, use Table1 only if there was no previous febrile neutropenia. Confirm both counts, occurrence number, previous dose and G-CSF plan; otherwise use Table2. No automatic dose is calculated.

action.recommendation: 100% after first occurrence; second occurrence75% of previous cycle dose OR100% original regimen with G-CSF. Select the appropriate occurrence; no automatic re-escalation.

rules.explanation: 100% after first occurrence; second occurrence75% of previous cycle dose OR100% original regimen with G-CSF. Select the appropriate occurrence; no automatic re-escalation.

action.recommendation: First occurrence:75% of previous dose, or100% original regimen with G-CSF. If ANC>1.0,100% previous dose may be considered at consultant discretion.

rules.explanation: First occurrence:75% of previous dose, or100% original regimen with G-CSF. If ANC>1.0,100% previous dose may be considered at consultant discretion.

action.recommendation: Delay until ANC≥1.5 and platelets≥100 then75% previous dose. After first occurrence,100% original regimen with G-CSF is a consultant-selected alternative; do not use it after an unspecified recurrence.

rules.explanation: Delay until ANC≥1.5 and platelets≥100 then75% previous dose. After first occurrence,100% original regimen with G-CSF is a consultant-selected alternative; do not use it after an unspecified recurrence.

rules.explanation: Second occurrence: delay until ANC≥1.5 then75% previous dose; alternative75% original regimen with G-CSF requires explicit consultant selection.

action.recommendation: ANC lies between1.49 and1.5 in the printed after-delay table; do not round into a dose band.

rules.explanation: ANC lies between1.49 and1.5 in the printed after-delay table; do not round into a dose band.

action.recommendation: Third or later low-count occurrence is not specified by Table1; consultant review, no extrapolated dose.

action.recommendation: Complete DPD deficiency: do not administer 5-fluorouracil. Specialist alternative treatment required.

rules.explanation: Complete DPD deficiency: do not administer 5-fluorouracil. Specialist alternative treatment required.

action.recommendation: Partial DPD deficiency: consider reduced starting5-FU dose; no universal percentage is given here. Escalation only after careful monitoring and prescribing review.

rules.explanation: Partial DPD deficiency: consider reduced starting5-FU dose; no universal percentage is given here. Escalation only after careful monitoring and prescribing review.

action.recommendation: Establish DPD testing/result before first5-FU. Renal impairment can confound uracil phenotyping; consider genotyping.

rules.explanation: Establish DPD testing/result before first5-FU. Renal impairment can confound uracil phenotyping; consider genotyping.

action.recommendation: Confirm DPD test/result before first5-FU; missing information is not a normal result.

rules.explanation: Confirm DPD test/result before first5-FU; missing information is not a normal result.

action.recommendation: NCCP states concurrent radiotherapy with FEC is contraindicated. Agree a sequential plan; do not automatically overlap treatments.

rules.explanation: NCCP states concurrent radiotherapy with FEC is contraindicated. Agree a sequential plan; do not automatically overlap treatments.

action.recommendation: 5-FU is contraindicated when bilirubin>85µmol/L OR AST>180U/L. This AST threshold is absolute U/L, not×ULN.

rules.explanation: 5-FU is contraindicated when bilirubin>85µmol/L OR AST>180U/L. This AST threshold is absolute U/L, not×ULN.

action.recommendation: Exactly85µmol/L bilirubin or180U/L AST is unassigned between the printed5-FU rows. Resolve the boundary before dose selection.

rules.explanation: Exactly85µmol/L bilirubin or180U/L AST is unassigned between the printed5-FU rows. Resolve the boundary before dose selection.

action.recommendation: For moderate hepatic impairment the source advises reduce initial dose by one third; reconcile absolute AST/bilirubin restrictions and current dose first. Subsequent escalation is a clinical decision if no toxicity.

rules.explanation: For moderate hepatic impairment the source advises reduce initial dose by one third; reconcile absolute AST/bilirubin restrictions and current dose first. Subsequent escalation is a clinical decision if no toxicity.

action.recommendation: For severe hepatic impairment the source advises reduce initial dose by one half; reconcile absolute AST/bilirubin restrictions and current dose first. Subsequent escalation is a clinical decision if no toxicity.

rules.explanation: For severe hepatic impairment the source advises reduce initial dose by one half; reconcile absolute AST/bilirubin restrictions and current dose first. Subsequent escalation is a clinical decision if no toxicity.

action.recommendation: Consider5-FU dose reduction in severe renal impairment; specialist decision, no fixed percentage.

rules.explanation: Consider5-FU dose reduction in severe renal impairment; specialist decision, no fixed percentage.

action.recommendation: Delay until stomatitis has recovered, then75% of Day 1 dose of the previous cycle; maintain this reduction subsequently. Verify clinical recovery and current dose.

rules.explanation: Delay until stomatitis has recovered, then75% of Day 1 dose of the previous cycle; maintain this reduction subsequently. Verify clinical recovery and current dose.

action.recommendation: Discontinue5-FU for new ischaemic symptoms or arrhythmia and urgently investigate. Rechallenge is generally not recommended; specialist cardiac review required.

rules.explanation: Discontinue5-FU for new ischaemic symptoms or arrhythmia and urgently investigate. Rechallenge is generally not recommended; specialist cardiac review required.
